newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's BIAT reports higher '96 profits.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's BIAT reports higher '96 profits.

text.p: Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie (BIAT), the third largest bank in Tunisia, said on Tuesday it made a 11.77 million dinars ($12.2 million) provisional profit in 1996.
BIAT had reported a 9.63 million dinars net profits for 1995, from 8.62 million dinars in 1994.
BIAT, owned by a majority of Tunisian private shareholders, has a capital of 60 million dinars.

Other shareholders include Italy's San Paolo Bank Holding, Morocco's Wafa Bank, Saudi's National Commercial Bank of Jeddah, France's Societe Marseillaise de Credit and Caisse Centrale des Banques Populaires, Kuwait's Al Ahli Bank and Bank of Kuwait and the Middle East. ($=1.04 dinar)
